attendance_leave_type_custom_rules.name: attendance_leave_type_custom_rules
attendance_leave_type_custom_rules.value: ("attendance_leave_type"."statutory_kind" = 'custom') = ("attendance_leave_type"."paid_percent" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_leave_type"."requires_balance" IS NOT NULL)

attendance_shift_break.name: attendance_shift_break
attendance_shift_break.value: ("attendance_shift"."break_starts_at" IS NULL AND "attendance_shift"."break_ends_at" IS NULL) OR ("attendance_shift"."break_starts_at" >= "attendance_shift"."starts_at" AND "attendance_shift"."break_ends_at" > "attendance_shift"."break_starts_at" AND "attendance_shift"."break_ends_at" <= "attendance_shift"."ends_at")
